bill.title: Individual income tax: credit; credit for owners of agricultural assets who sell or rent agricultural assets to beginning farmers; provide for. Amends 1967 PA 281 (MCL 206.1 - 206.847) by adding sec. 281.   TIE BAR WITH: HB 6437'26

posted_text:
🔑 MI HB 6438 — Michigan Farmers Get a Tax Break on Land Deals

Michigan is offering a tax credit to farmers who buy or rent land from new farmers.

If you're a farmer selling land or renting it out under a specific agreement, you could get a credit up to the amount on your certificate from the Department of Agriculture and Rural Development.

To claim this, you’ll need a certificate and proof the agreement was active during the tax year.

If you’re part of a farming business, you can carry over any unused credit for up to five years.
